claims.claim_text: Long-standing JDA with BMW (since 2016/2017) for joint development and vehicle integration of solid-state battery cells; amended in September 2024 to extend the JDA term until certain development milestones are reached (with BMW termination rights beginning Dec 31, 2025); BMW i7 test vehicle with Solid Power cells unveiled May 2025.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.source_quote: BMW Group s introduction of an i7 test vehicle featuring our cells and solid-state battery technology in May 2025 was a significant achievement in our partnership with BMW. ... we further amended our JDA with BMW to (i) extend the term of the JDA until we hit certain development milestones; provided that BMW will have termination rights in certain circumstances beginning on December 31, 2025

claims.claim_text: Ford JDA, extended Dec 2024 then again Dec 31 2025 in connection with the winding up of cell development activities with Ford, now expected to expire March 31, 2026; company aims to pursue electrolyte supply to Ford post-expiration.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.source_quote: Effective December 31, 2025, in connection with the winding up of our cell development activities with Ford, we and Ford amended the JDA to further extend the expiration date to March 31, 2026 ... We expect the JDA will expire by its terms on March 31, 2026.

claims.claim_text: SK On Agreements (Jan 2024): R&D technology license ($20M paid in milestones 2024-2027), line installation agreement (~$22M to install pilot cell manufacturing line at SK On Korea facility), electrolyte supply agreement (>=8 metric tons through 2030 for ~$8.3M). FAT completed; SAT substantially completed, expected Q1 2026.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.object_value: SK On Co., Ltd. (Korean Tier-1 battery maker, foreign filer)
claims.source_quote: Under the SK On R&D license, SK On licensed our cell designs and manufacturing processes in exchange for payments totaling $20 million from 2024 to 2027 ... line installation agreement ... estimated $22 million ... SK On is required to purchase at least eight metric tons of electrolyte from Solid Power through 2030 ... we expect to receive at least $8.3 million from these electrolyte sales.

claims.claim_text: October 2025 Joint Evaluation Agreement with Samsung SDI and BMW AG: Solid Power supplies electrolyte; Samsung SDI fabricates separator/catholyte and builds cells; BMW + Samsung SDI agree on performance parameters. Demonstration vehicle goal. Marketed as 'meaningful progress on our path towards commercialization.'
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.source_quote: In October 2025, we announced a collaboration with Samsung SDI and BMW AG to pursue development and validation of a demonstration vehicle powered by all-solid-state battery technology. We entered into a Joint Evaluation Agreement with Samsung SDI and BMW AG that outlines the collaborative framework.

claims.claim_text: DOE Assistance Agreement entered January 2025 (as amended May 2025) under Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act / Bipartisan Infrastructure Law for grant of up to $50 million to install continuous manufacturing process of sulfide-based solid electrolyte; Solid Power cost-share obligation $60M; $3.1M received in 2025; $6.0M of government revenue / grant income in 2025 vs $2.7M in 2024.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.source_quote: In January 2025, we entered into an assistance agreement (as amended in May 2025, the Assistance Agreement ) with the U.S. Department of Energy ( DOE ) for a grant of up to $50 million under the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, or Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. ... Our cost share obligation under the Assistance Agreement is $60 million

claims.claim_text: As of February 1, 2026: 24 issued US patents, 100 pending US patent applications, 111 non-US/PCT patents and applications. Sulfide-based solid electrolyte materials and methods of production make up the largest portion of patent application filings. Patents begin expiring in 2036. Also includes exclusive licenses from CU Boulder and Oak Ridge National Lab.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.object_value: 24 US issued patents, 100 US pending, 111 non-US patents/apps
claims.source_quote: As of February 1, 2026, we owned or exclusively licensed 24 issued United States patents, 100 pending United States patent applications, 111 non-United States and PCT patents and applications

claims.claim_text: Plans to commission continuous electrolyte production pilot line by end of 2026; expected to expand annual electrolyte production capacity to up to 75 metric tons; intends to pursue partnership in Republic of Korea for facility producing up to 500 metric tons annually. Pilot line is DOE-funded.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.object_value: continuous electrolyte pilot line (75 MT/yr) by end of 2026; ROK partner facility up to 500 MT/yr (aspirational)
claims.source_quote: We expect to commission our continuous electrolyte production line by the end of 2026. Once installed, we expect this pilot line to expand our annual electrolyte production capacity to up to 75 metric tons. ... a facility capable of producing up to 500 metric tons of electrolyte annually.

claims.claim_text: 2025 revenue mix: $21.7M total = $6.0M government + $15.8M collaborative; collaborative primarily from SK On Agreements; BMW related-party revenue collapsed from $5.41M (2024) to only $0.189M (2025) - cell-material sample revenue only. No commercial production revenue. Operating loss $122.6M / accumulated deficit $274.9M.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.object_value: $21.7M total revenue (mostly SK On milestone + DOE grant); BMW revenue declined 96% YoY
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company recognized $ 189 of revenue from BMW ... For the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company recognized $ 5,410 of revenue from BMW ... Total revenue and grant income $ 21,747 ... operating loss of approximately $122.6 million ... accumulated deficit of approximately $274.9 million

claims.claim_text: Total liquidity $336.5M at 12/31/2025; raised $88.8M net via ATM in 2025 (avg price $5.06/share); raised additional $122.2M net via Registered Direct Offering in January 2026. Stock repurchase program: 2025 repurchases at avg $1.05/share (vs ATM sales at $5.06), suggesting share price volatility / wide range during the year.
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.object_value: $88.8M ATM 2025 + $122.2M Reg Direct Jan 2026; ATM avg $5.06/sh; buyback avg $1.05/sh
claims.source_quote: we sold 18,023,085 shares of common stock at an average price of $5.06 per share ... we repurchased 3,361,396 shares of common stock at an average cost of $1.05 per share ... In January 2026, we received net proceeds of $122.2 million, after deducting fees and before expenses, from a registered direct offering

claims.claim_text: BMW Group introduced an i7 test vehicle featuring Solid Power cells and solid-state battery technology in May 2025 - presented as significant milestone in the partnership. Demonstration vehicle status (not production vehicle / not SOP).
claims.subject: Solid Power
claims.object_value: BMW i7 test vehicle (May 2025, demonstration only)
claims.source_quote: BMW Group s introduction of an i7 test vehicle featuring our cells and solid-state battery technology in May 2025 was a significant achievement in our partnership with BMW.
